description: Synthetic manual import samples (format edr-manual-import/1; provider-ports section 1.6). Valid samples describe the domestic league "Liga Manual Sintética" with named stages; the equivalence set is the reference-shaped matchday of R-267. Each invalid sample has exactly one defect, named by its expected ImportProblem.
